title: Brazilian Shrimp Skewers with Mexican Twist
description: A fusion dish featuring succulent shrimp marinated in a zesty Brazilian-inspired mixture, served with a crispy Mexican flair.

ingredients.name: brazilian seasoning
ingredients.notes: containing cumin, paprika, and chili flakes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Brazilian seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Thread the shrimp onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each shrimp.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the crispy bacon in a pan until crispy.
Flake the crispy bacon into small pieces and sprinkle over the shrimp skewers.
